description: Circuits vélo pour le territoire de Cap Atlantique is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Cap Atlantique. Existing bike tours in the territory of Cap Atlantique (Asserac, Batz-sur-Mer, Camoël, Férel, Guérande, Herbignac, La Baule-Escoublac, La Turballe, Le Croisic, Le Pouliguen, Mesquer, Penestin, Piriac-sur-Mer, Saint-Lyphard, Saint-Molf). Coverage: Cap Atlantique. The portal shows the English title as "Cycling tours for the territory of Cape Atlantic" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Cap Atlantique. Its keywords include culture-tourisme, itineraire, pratique-sportive, velo, piste-cyclable, mobilite. The listing shows 4 download or service links in JSON, ZIP, CSV. The listing shows 2025-04-10 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
